t: When you know it was your own doing
a: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
p: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā, wa in lam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā la-nakūnanna mina-l-khāsirīn.
m: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
